scenario.description: Rowan has a spare furnished room and must decide whether to make a three-month room-share arrangement with Casey, settling the rent, deposit, move-in date, utility split, household quiet hours, and trial period after consulting the people gathered at home.

agents.name: Taylor
agents.role: Neighbor Familiar with Other Interested Renters

shared_context.S1: Rowan has one furnished spare room available in the house.
shared_context.S2: Casey has expressed interest in a three-month room-share.
shared_context.S3: Rowan makes the final decision about whether to agree and what terms to use.
shared_context.S4: As part of the household's normal decision process, Rowan asks each person present to state any relevant terms, schedule needs, or other offers before an agreement is made.

PF1.text: Casey's concrete proposal is $700 per month, a $350 deposit, move-in on Saturday, May 10, a three-month stay, a 50/50 split of household utilities, and a 14-day trial period.

PF2.text: Morgan starts a bakery shift at 05:00 and needs the household to agree to quiet hours from 22:00 to 07:00 every day.

PF3.text: Taylor heard directly from Devon at the neighborhood market that Devon would pay $750 per month for only one month in the room, and Taylor has not shared that offer with Rowan or the others.

acceptance_conditions: Casey must be selected for the room-share.
The monthly rent must be exactly $700.
The move-in date must be Saturday, May 10, allowing ordinary ordinal formatting such as May 10th.
The stay must be for exactly three months.
Quiet hours must be set from 22:00 to 07:00 every day, allowing ordinary 24-hour or 12-hour formatting.
A 14-day trial period must be included in the verbal agreement.
The competing offer must be recorded as $750 per month for one month.
Morgan's quiet-hours requirement must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C4: decisions['move_in_date'] in ['Saturday, May 10', 'Saturday, May 10th', 'Saturday May 10', 'Saturday May 10th']
content_checks.C6: decisions['quiet_hours'] in ['22:00 to 07:00 daily', '10:00 PM to 7:00 AM daily', '22:00-07:00', '10 PM–7 AM', '10 PM-7 AM', '22:00–07:00 daily', '10:00 PM–7:00 AM daily']

decisive_facts.why: Casey's stated proposal fixes the selected roommate, $700 rent, $350 deposit, May 10 move-in, three-month term, 50/50 utilities, and 14-day trial period instead of leaving those choices to guesswork.
Morgan's 05:00 bakery start changes the household rule from unspecified quiet expectations to exact daily quiet hours of 22:00-07:00 and supplies the fact that must be cited.
Taylor's direct report of Devon's offer changes the comparison record to exactly $750 per month for one month rather than an unsupported or generic alternative.
